title: Public Education for Elderly on How to Spot Impending Dizzy Spells to Prevent Falls and Injuries
what_it_is: Public Education for Elderly on How to Spot Impending Dizzy Spells to Prevent Falls and Injuries

sections.label: Seniors attending health talks
sections.summary: Over 6,000 seniors attended health talks in the past year, learning tips such as removing home clutter to pre-empt falls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Over 6,000 seniors have attended these health talks across the past year, acquiring tips such as removing clutter in the home to pre-empt the risks of falls.

sections.label: HPB senior exercise classes
sections.summary: HPB holds weekly senior exercise classes in over 600 community spaces, with over 50,000 seniors attending in 2019 and about 160 in a pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The HPB holds weekly senior exercise classes in more than 600 community spaces island-wide and more than 50,000 seniors attended these classes in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To date, some 160 seniors have participated in the pilot programme and most have shown improvement in their strength, balance and flexibility.

sections.label: Seniors in HAPPY programme
sections.summary: More than 700 seniors have participated in HAPPY as of January this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: More than 700 seniors have participated in HAPPY as of January this year.

sections.label: Trial of personal alert button
sections.summary: SNDGO and MOH are trialing a personal alert button in some homes of seniors living in Tampines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But, I think what we need to do is to carefully analyse the evidence available to see how effective they can be if we implement it at scale because we need to scale this up for a rapidly ageing population and increasingly more seniors living alone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, Smart Nation and Digital Government Office or SNDGO and MOH are currently trialing out a personal alert button in some homes of seniors living in Tampines.

sections.label: Extending personal alert button
sections.summary: The personal alert button is being extended to homes of seniors in 53 one-room rental blocks, connecting to a Senior Activity Centre or Careline.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we are doing now is to extend this device beyond Tampines, to homes of seniors living in 53 1-room rental blocks across the island.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This new personal alert button, which when triggered, is either connected to a Senior Activity Centre or if it is not available, then to Careline, which will then assess the kind of assistance we need to give to the seniors.

sections.label: HPB YouTube workout sessions
sections.summary: During COVID-19, HPB posted workout sessions on its YouTube channel, which have garnered about 61,000 views to date.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, during this COVID-19 period especially, when we ask seniors to stay at home because they are the most vulnerable, in order to ensure that they can still remain active and engaged, HPB, for instance, has got a series of a workout sessions that they have put on their YouTube channel.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: These have garnered about 61,000 views till date.
